name: gl-split-slide-in-horizontal
title: SplitSlideInHorizontal transition
description: The incoming image slides in as two halves moving horizontally in opposite directions. Load vendor/glintmotion/hyper-shader.js, then this file, then call HyperShader.init({ transitions: [{ time, shader: "gl-split-slide-in-horizontal", duration }] }).
